estimand_warning: Not the same quantity as denali's 0.465 (one screen, Perturb-seq, program-level R_p, raw-size predictor). This is the distribution of a per-screen size-only R^2 (log-size predictor) across published screens.
source: BioGRID ORCS 2.0.18, human, MIT licence. 1,952 screens / 418 publications.
inclusion: HIT=YES count >= 20 and >= 10,000 genes measured; >= 8 usable sets (a set is usable with >= 5 measured members)

publication_level_pseudo_replication.why: The screen is not the independent unit. One publication contributes up to hundreds of screens sharing a library, cell line and hit rule, so screen-level quantiles let a single lab set the median. Each publication is collapsed to its median screen first. This correction moves the headline share and is reported alongside it, never instead of it.
